removed: Removed "{name}". Extensions installed from it stay, but stop upgrading until it is added again with the same address.
markets_footer: A market is an index of extensions (persona-extensions.json) published by a website or a git / GitHub repository. A GitHub market can take a read-only token: private repos need one to be read, and public repos get a higher rate limit so they're less likely to be throttled. The token is stored encrypted on the hub, sent only to that market and never shown again. git: markets use the hub machine's own SSH credentials. Removing a market doesn't affect extensions installed from it.
no_markets_detail: Add an https address, {github} or {git}. Once the hub reads its index, you can browse and install its extensions here.
token_rate_limit_hint: Without a token, GitHub allows only 60 reads an hour, shared by every device on the same network. Adding a GitHub token raises that to 5,000, including for public repositories (for a fine-grained token, choose Public repositories and leave every permission unchecked).
catalog_footer: Installing an extension runs a new program on the hub machine. Install shows what it can do first and installs only once you agree; packages are checked against the market's sha256. Upgrade, roll back or uninstall market extensions in the list above.
manage_above: Installed from this market; manage it in the list above.
previewing: Downloading and checking what it can do
token_git_placeholder: git: markets don't use a token
token_placeholder: Required for private repos, optional for public ones
token_git_hint: git: markets are read with the hub machine's own SSH credentials and take no token.
token_hint: For GitHub, use a read-only fine-grained token: for a private repo, give it Contents read access; for a public repo, choose Public repositories with no permissions, which raises the limit from 60 reads an hour to 5,000. It's stored encrypted on the hub and never shown again.
adding: Reading its index once; it's added only if that works…
new_token: New token (the current one isn't shown)
token_save_hint: After saving, the hub reads the index again with it.
official_unreachable: Can't reach the official extensions right now. Try again later.
catalog_unreadable: Can't read the marketplace right now. Its extensions show up here once it can be read
token_create_hint: No token yet? Create one on GitHub: the name, purpose and a one-year expiry are filled in and no permissions are needed. Click Generate token, then paste it above.
